pairs.subject: build-economics
pairs.evidence: src/lib/ue5-bridge/build-health.ts:246 The build-health route (src/app/api/ue5-bridge/build-health/route.ts:29) serves getBuildHealthReport, and its duration-regression baseline filters the earlier builds by success alone, so Editor and Game targets, Development and other configurations, and cold and incremental UBT runs are averaged into one baseline. The headless_builds schema (build-pipeline.ts:49-67) has no cold/incremental or machine column and no peak-memory sample, so a 'duration spiked N%' alert is a number with no scenario attached, which is the failure build-measurement names.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/ue5-bridge/build-health.ts:246 Wall-clock is recorded per build and there is a rolling-baseline regression alert, so a time series exists. But the baseline is not partitioned by target, configuration or build type; the schema records no cold/warm/incremental label and no machine; and peak memory is never sampled. A cold rebuild that follows incremental builds will raise a false 'critical' alert, and a real regression on one target can be hidden by the others.

pairs.registryProposal: The build-measurement technique could say outright that a rolling-baseline regression alert must partition its baseline by scenario (target, configuration, cold/incremental). Mixing them gives a detector whose false positives teach people to ignore it.

pairs.subject: build-economics
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_debug/_shared/data-perf.ts:26 Here 'build' means a shipped game version measured at runtime (fps, memory, drawCalls per v0.8.x), not the cost of compiling it. A grep of every sub_debug file found no hits for compile, incremental, pdb, cache or UnrealBuildTool, so this dashboard has no build cost (wall-clock, peak compile memory, cache disk) for build-economics to govern.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_debug/_shared/data-perf.ts:21 This peak-memory figure is runtime game memory from a fixture, not memory sampled during a build.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_debug/_shared/data-perf.ts:10 No build cache is created or read; a grep for 'cache' found nothing in sub_debug.
